home.title: Back up

snap.noDest: Choose a destination to see its backups.

settings.keepHint: Older backups are deleted after each backup.
settings.reminderHint: Get a notification reminding you to back up.

reminder.body: Back up your files to keep them safe.

home.title: Sauvegarder
home.noDest: Choisissez où enregistrer vos sauvegardes pour commencer.

snap.noDest: Choisissez une destination pour voir ses sauvegardes.
